verifications.claim: Netflix is streaming the NASA Artemis II lunar flyby live on Monday, April 6, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Netflix will stream the event for subscribers starting at 1:00 p.m. ET' on Monday; R3: 'Livestream ... on Netflix' on 'Monday, April 6, 2026'; R4: 'NASA’s live coverage ... on Netflix'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm Netflix live streaming the Artemis II lunar flyby on the specified date.

verifications.claim: Netflix's streaming of the NASA Artemis II lunar flyby starts at 1 p.m. ET.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'starting at 1:00 p.m. ET'; R3: 'Live coverage begins at 1 p.m. ET ... on Netflix'; R4: '1 p.m. NASA’s live coverage ... on Netflix'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state Netflix coverage starts at 1 p.m. ET.

verifications.claim: Netflix has a partnership with NASA.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Netflix struck a deal with NASA last summer to bring NASA+ to Netflix'
verifications.reasoning: Direct mention of a deal/partnership between Netflix and NASA.

verifications.claim: Netflix is broadcasting the NASA Artemis II mission's closest approach to the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: streams 'lunar flyby'; R3: coverage 'through 9:45 p.m.' includes '7:02 p.m. Orion will make its closest approach'; R4: coverage includes '7:00 p.m. Orion has reached its closest approach'
verifications.reasoning: Flyby coverage explicitly includes the closest approach timing within broadcast window.

verifications.claim: Netflix's coverage of the NASA Artemis II lunar flyby is scheduled to run until 9:45 p.m. ET.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Live coverage begins at 1 p.m. ET ... and continues through 9:45 p.m., ... on Netflix'
verifications.reasoning: Exact end time for coverage including Netflix directly stated.

verifications.claim: The main NASA Artemis II lunar flyby and close approach occur throughout the afternoon.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R3: observation '2:45 p.m.', closest '7:02 p.m.'; R4: observation '2:45 p.m.', closest '7:00 p.m.'
verifications.reasoning: Events start in afternoon but extend into evening (e.g., closest approach at 7 p.m.), less precise than 'throughout the afternoon'.

verifications.claim: The NASA Artemis II mission has potential communication loss as it goes behind the Moon around 6:44 p.m. ET.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'lose contact ... as they pass behind the far side of the moon'; R3: '6:44 p.m.: ... lose communication'; R4: '6:44 p.m. ... communications blackout as it passes behind the Moon'
verifications.reasoning: Exact time and cause of communication loss directly confirmed.

verifications.claim: The NASA Artemis II lunar flyby feed is available on NASA+.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'on Netflix, NASA+, and other major platforms'; R3: 'on NASA+'; R4: 'on NASA+'
verifications.reasoning: All relevant sources list NASA+ as a streaming platform.

verifications.claim: The NASA Artemis II lunar flyby feed is available on YouTube.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'NASA's YouTube page also provides 24/7 coverage'; R4: 'NASA’s YouTube channel'

verifications.claim: The Netflix stream covers the crew of four astronauts.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: 'NASA’s Artemis II crew ... streams live ... on Netflix'; R3/R4: Netflix streams flyby/mission with four-person crew
verifications.reasoning: Stream is of crew's flyby mission but focuses on event/spacecraft views, not explicitly crew footage.

verifications.claim: The NASA Artemis II crew consists of four astronauts.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The four-person crew'; R3: 'four-person crew'; R4: 'Artemis II crew of NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, and Christina Koch, along with CSA astronaut Jeremy Hansen'
verifications.reasoning: Consistently stated as four astronauts across sources.

verifications.claim: The NASA Artemis II crew includes the first woman to travel around the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'the first woman (mission specialist Christina Koch) ... to venture near the moon' in context of lunar flyby around far side
verifications.reasoning: Directly identifies Christina Koch as first woman on this mission type.

verifications.claim: The NASA Artemis II crew includes the first Canadian to travel around the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Canadian Space Agency astronaut Jeremy Hansen'; R3: 'first ... Canadian (mission specialist Jeremy Hansen) to venture near the moon'
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly first Canadian, matching mission description.

verifications.claim: The live event is being broadcast directly through the Netflix platform
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'watch the Artemis II lunar flyby live on Netflix'; R3: 'Livestream ... on Netflix'; R4: 'live coverage ... on Netflix'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm direct live streaming on Netflix platform.
